source_title: in spite of meeting requirements, llm won't run on gpu.
source_text: I am having difficulties running the LLM(deepseek) on my GPU, it will only run on my CPU. I have downloaded the proper drivers, I have the CUDA toolkit installed, and I have initiated a Docker container running open-webui, and tagged it with --gpu 1 which is my 4090, as gpu0 is my k series i9, so i dont want to use 'all'. It agrees I have a 4090 and will run the n-body sample function on all of my 16000 cuda cores in 77ms, so I must be really close. I have WSL 2 engine checked in docker's options. I have done this all from scratch after having all the drivers and the cuda toolkit 12.8 installed. I can successfully run the 70b model on my system through owui, but obviously is too much for a 12900k. It is evident it only runs on the cpu as its slow and heats up the cpu and gpu sits idle.
